title: Phonebox gives AI agents metered cloud Android devices
friendlyTitle: Phonebox gives AI agents an Android phone in the cloud
summary: Phonebox launched cloud Android devices that agents can inspect and control through an API, TypeScript SDK, command line or MCP connection. Devices retain apps and signed-in accounts while parked, are billed by the second while running and include activity logs and spending limits.
friendlySummary: An AI agent can start a cloud Android phone, read its screen, tap buttons, type and use apps. The phone keeps its setup when parked, and customers pay only while it is running.
whyItMatters: Developers can test mobile apps or automate services that lack APIs without maintaining a physical device lab. Persistent sign-ins and screen control are powerful permissions, so dedicated accounts, narrow budgets and review of sensitive actions should be part of the setup.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can help developers test phone apps and automate tasks that have no normal API. Use test accounts and spending limits because the agent can control a real signed-in device.
